title: Read-only local pi workers: pinned pushes fail every wip checkpoint
body:
workerconfig.go writes `remote` unconditionally, so a read-only (review) attempt on the local pi runner still installs the workspace checkpoints — whose every push the read-only grade's git pins refuse (grade.go readOnlyPins). Each tool round then throws into onReport and logs a failed checkpoint, the run has none of the wip durability the local rung exists for, and the new finish-phase salvage would go on to `git add -A && git commit` locally on an attempt whose grade granted no ref to advance. No test covers a read-only local durable run; a dispatched review would run visibly broken at its first tool round.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/workerconfig.go writeWorkerConfig (Remote: record.Remote, no read-only check); internal/exec/subprocess/grade.go:215 readOnlyPins; harness/src/workspace/checkpoints.ts afterTools throws on a failed push
